batch_prep.station: Sunday — The Component Station (25 min, this is the whole week)
tasks: Restaurant Dropout builds a week out of shared components. Make these five and four dinners plus both lunches assemble themselves.
CITRUS MARINADE: stir 1/2 c orange juice, 1/4 c soy, 1/4 c olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, zest+juice of 1 lime, 2 grated garlic, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp each cumin/chili powder/oregano, 1/2 tsp sugar.
CUMIN-LIME VINAIGRETTE: whisk 3 tbsp olive oil, 1.5 tbsp honey, juice of 1.5 limes, 1 tbsp white wine vinegar, 3/4 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp salt.

ELOTE SALSA: sauté 1 minced shallot in olive oil 2 min. Add 1 c corn + 1 diced red bell pepper + 1/2 tsp salt, cook 4 min. Cool 5 min, then stir in lime juice, 2 tbsp cilantro, 1/2 tsp chili powder, 1/4 c cotija.
⚠️ TWO CREMAS, TWO JARS. Restaurant Dropout's crema is avocado-based and Austin is allergic.
CAMERON'S — blend 2 avocados, 2 serranos, 1/4 c cilantro, 1/4 c scallions, 1/2 c Greek yogurt, 2 tbsp lime, 1/4 c water, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp sugar. Label it CAMERON.
AUSTIN'S — blend 1 c Greek yogurt, 1/4 c sour cream, 2 seeded jalapeños, 1/4 c cilantro, 1/4 c scallions, 2 tbsp lime, 2 tbsp water, 1 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp cumin. Label it AUSTIN.
CRISPY TORTILLA STRIPS: slice 6 corn tortillas into 2-inch strips, shallow fry in 1/2 inch of oil 3–4 min until golden, salt while hot. Store at room temp, NOT the fridge.

batch_prep.station: Sunday — Chicken + Rice (20 min, covers all 7 lunches)
tasks: Start 3 cups brown rice in the rice cooker. Hands off.
Pull both rotisserie chickens. Shred with two forks.
SET ASIDE 20 OZ PLAIN. That's for the Thu–Sun corn rice bowls. Do this before you dress anything.
Toss the rest with 1/4 cup Citrus Marinade.
SAVORY CORN RICE (double batch): melt 2 tbsp butter, add 1 c corn + 1 tsp granulated bouillon, toast 4 min. Add cooked rice, toast 4 more. Half goes to lunches, half to the Asada dinner.
Build 6 Fiesta salad containers (spring mix, dressed chicken, elote salsa) and 8 corn rice bowls.
Vinaigrette, cotija, tortilla strips, and crema ALL stay separate until eating time. This is the difference between a good Thursday lunch and a soggy one.
This week burns all 16 oz shrimp, all 2 lb tilapia, about 14 of your 24 oz ground beef, and 3 of your 5 salmon fillets.
2 salmon fillets and roughly 10 oz of ground beef stay in the freezer. Six dinners is already four seafood nights — pushing salmon to five would be too much.
The 10 oz of beef is Wednesday's burger meat plus a little slack. The buns get used either way.
Nothing below is locked to a night. Pick whatever sounds good.
Only real constraint: Thursday you're out.
Fiesta salad Mon–Wed, corn rice bowls Thu–Sun. That's freshness, not preference.
Every dinner is 35 minutes or less once the components are made.
